comments.body:
Gold + Strange Powder + Gaseous Drug + Adept's Robe turns into Alchemist Robe.
You take Alchemist Robe + Special Purchase Bonds + 5x10mil Cheques + Orichcalcum to transform it into the Alchemist Robe EX. Uroboros is strongly recommended for
both stages.
